# DeedHound

> Sheriff Sales & Foreclosure Auctions. Free, unofficial lists of upcoming sheriff sales and foreclosure auctions compiled daily from lists published by county sheriffs and Kentucky master commissioners. Always verify with the official county source before bidding; not legal or financial advice.

## States

- [Ohio sheriff sales](https://deedhound.app/ohio/): 272 upcoming sales in 27 counties, data as of Oct 30, 2026 6:03 AM ET or later
- [Pennsylvania sheriff sales](https://deedhound.app/pennsylvania/): 1860 upcoming sales in 3 counties, data as of Oct 30, 2026 11:00 AM ET or later
- [Kentucky sheriff sales](https://deedhound.app/kentucky/): 97 upcoming sales in 2 counties, data as of Oct 30, 2026 2:49 PM ET or later
- [New Jersey sheriff sales](https://deedhound.app/new-jersey/): 1277 upcoming sales in 17 counties, data as of Oct 28, 2026 7:03 AM ET or later

## Guides

- [How Deal Check works](https://deedhound.app/deal-check/): how listings are graded Strong / Fair / Pass from published bids and official values
- [How to pay for a sheriff sale](https://deedhound.app/financing/)
